newsitem.title: USA: Invacare boosts Healthdyne bid to $15 per share. [CORRECTED 22:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Invacare boosts Healthdyne bid to $15 per share. [CORRECTED 22:10 GMT]

text.p: Medical equipment maker Invacare Corp. said on Wednesday it boosted its hostile bid to acquire rival Healthdyne Technologies Inc. to $200 million from $180 million (corrects from "to $191 million from $166 million").

Invacare said its latest bid, worth $15 a share, was its "best and final" offer. Healthdyne rejected Invacare's original offer of $12 a share and its sweetened bid of $13 a share, both of which were made in January.
Invacare said it would not raise its bid again for Healthdyne, calling its fight for the company "unnecessarily long and drawn-out."
Invacare also said that if Healthdyne shareholders did not approve the transaction, it would seek to sell some or all of the 600,000 Healthdyne shares it now owns.
Officials from Healthdyne were not immediately available to comment.
